repo.name: Aquamarine
repo.description: Tweaks by Thonin for rootless jailbreaks (iOS 15+).

com.thonin.chargewatts.tagline: Live charging watts under your battery icon.
com.thonin.chargewatts.description:
Shows how many watts are really going into your iPhone while it charges — a small pill right under the battery icon, on the Home Screen, Lock Screen and in portrait apps.

- Reads the power chip's own charge counters, so it updates twice a second instead of every 20 seconds
- Accurate to within a few percent of the battery driver's own energy counter
- Hides when unplugged, in landscape apps and while the screen is off (no battery cost)
- Touches pass straight through it
com.thonin.chargewatts.compat: iOS 15 – 18 · rootless (Dopamine). Tested on iPhone XS Max, iOS 18.4.1.

com.thonin.doubletaplock.tagline: Double-tap to lock — and to unlock.
com.thonin.doubletaplock.description:
Double-tap empty space to lock or unlock your iPhone.

- Home Screen and app switcher: double-tap empty space to lock
- Lock Screen: double-tap empty space to unlock — exactly like swiping up, so Face ID or your passcode is still required
- Taps on icons, widgets, notifications, the flashlight/camera buttons and the passcode keypad keep working normally
com.thonin.doubletaplock.compat: iOS 15 – 18 · rootless (Dopamine). Tested on iPhone XS Max, iOS 18.4.1.
